pages.title: The Quiet Center
pages.text: The Crafting Core sits at the center with the catalyst and, eventually, the result. Injectors hold the surrounding ingredients and drink OP while charging.$(br2)The Core searches along its six axes. Every injector must face it across a clear line.

pages.title: Measured Distances
pages.text: The measured cardinal distance is 3–16 blocks. Slightly off-axis positions may answer, but a clean cardinal circle is far easier to inspect.$(br2)Keep every sight line empty: even another injector between one injector and the Core breaks the arrangement.

pages.name: Example Four-Injector Layout
pages.text: One working example, not a mandatory shape. Purple only marks the real Crafting Core—do not place glass. Each injector stands three blocks away and faces inward.
